author: Channel 5 with Andrew Callaghan
description: Hey guys. This the last video I wanted to make, but unfortunately Nick Shirley has chosen to take a coward’s route after a self-admittedly disastrous appearance on C5, suggesting to his millions of followers that I manipulated our interview in post-production in a way that mischaracterized our interaction, which is the complete opposite of the truth. Still, Nick’s lies have led to a shitstorm of negative attention that I don’t have the patience to ignore. Busted out something real quick on plane wifi lol. Here is a video explaining everything with complete evidence and receipts. Greenland coverage coming soon!
title: Nick Shirley Response
